function.description: Search for products in the inventory based on specified criteria such as category, color, and size. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

function.name: order_status_check
function.description: Check the current status of an order by providing the order's unique identifier and the product name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

order_id.description: The unique identifier of the order. This is typically an alphanumeric code.

product.description: The name of the product ordered. For example, 'iPhone 12' or 'Samsung Galaxy S21'.

function.name: get_product_details
function.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific product, including color and size availability. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

product_id.description: The unique identifier of the product for which details are to be retrieved.

color.description: The color variant of the product, if specific color details are required.

size.description: The size of the product for which details are needed. Specify 'all sizes' if all size details are required.

message.content:
It’s possible that the “UK 34” label on this pair doesn’t match the exact waist measurement you’re used to.  
In the UK sizing system a number usually refers to the waist in **inches** – so a UK 34 is meant to be about **34 inches (≈86 cm)**. However, many factors can shift the real‑world size:

| Factor | How it can affect the fit |
|--------|---------------------------|
| **Brand** | Different manufacturers use slightly different cuts. |
| **Style** | Slim‑cut, relaxed‑fit, or tapered designs will have different waist widths even at the same nominal size. |
| **Fabric stretch** | Stretchy fabrics can shrink or expand after washing. |
| **Manufacturing tolerances** | Small variations in cutting or stitching can add/subtract a few centimeters. |

A ±5 cm difference is not unheard of when comparing two pairs from different lines or styles, even if both are labeled “UK 34.”  

If you’d like us to look up the exact product details (including the official waist measurement listed in the size chart), could you share the **product ID** or the **exact product name**? With that we can pull up the manufacturer’s size chart and confirm whether the product you received matches the advertised dimensions.  

Alternatively, you can check the product page on our site for the size chart and compare the waist measurement listed there with what you measured. If the product truly appears to be mislabeled or if you’re still unhappy with the fit, let us know and we’ll arrange a return or exchange for you.
